Below the ceiling, a spring k1 is connected vertically, and the lower end of the spring is connected to a pulley. A rope passes around the pulley, and its two ends go vertically downward and are respectively connected to object A and object B. Below B is connected a vertical spring k2, the lower end of spring k2 is connected to object C, and C is placed on the ground. Reasoning: From m_A=1/2 m_B=1/2 m_C=m, obtain m_A=m, m_B=m_C=2m. The process is slow, so it can be treated according to static equilibrium, taking vertically downward as positive. In the initial state A and B are at the same height and there is no external pulling force. For equilibrium of A: the rope tension T0=mg. For equilibrium of B: the weight of B is 2mg, and the upward pulling force of the rope is mg, so k2 still needs to exert mg upward on B, indicating that k2 is compressed by mg/k2 in the initial state. The pulley is subjected to the downward pulling forces of two sections of rope, with total magnitude 2T0=2mg, so the elastic force of k1 in the initial state is 2mg. In the final state C is just about to leave the ground, the supporting force of the ground on C is 0. From equilibrium of C, the upward elastic force of k2 on C is equal to 2mg, so k2 is stretched by 2mg/k2 in the final state. At this time, the downward pulling force of k2 on B is 2mg. B is subjected to weight 2mg and the downward pulling force of the spring 2mg, so the rope tension T1=4mg. When the pulley is in equilibrium, the elastic force of k1 is 2T1=8mg. Therefore the elastic force of k1 increases from 2mg to 8mg, and the pulley moves downward by Δp=(8mg-2mg)/k1=6mg/k1. k2 changes from being compressed by mg/k2 to being stretched by 2mg/k2, and its total length increases by 3mg/k2; when C is just about to leave the ground, it is still at the ground position, so B moves upward by 3mg/k2, namely ΔB=-3mg/k2. The rope length is unchanged, and the two vertical sections of rope pass around the pulley that moves with k1, so ΔA+ΔB=2Δp. Therefore the change in the vertical coordinate difference between A and B is ΔA-ΔB=2Δp-2ΔB=12mg/k1+6mg/k2. Since A and B are at the same height in the initial state, the height difference in the final state is this value.

method.method_draft: 先从图中确认结构：天花板下接竖直弹簧 k1，弹簧下端悬挂滑轮；绳子绕过滑轮，两端分别连 A、B；B 下方用竖直弹簧 k2 连到放在地面上的 C。取竖直向下为正，设滑轮位移为 Δp，A、B 位移为 ΔA、ΔB。由文字给出 mA=m，mB=mC=2m，过程缓慢故各时刻可按静力平衡处理。初态 A、B 等高且无外拉力，对 A 有绳张力 T0=mg；对 B 平衡可知 k2 对 B 向上作用 mg，即 k2 初态压缩 mg/k2；滑轮受两段绳向下拉力，故 k1 初态弹力 2mg。末态 C 刚离地，对 C 有 k2 弹力向上等于 2mg，故 k2 末态拉伸 2mg/k2；对 B 平衡得绳张力 T1=2mg+2mg=4mg；滑轮平衡得 k1 末态弹力 2T1=8mg。因此滑轮因 k1 弹力增大而下移 Δp=(8mg-2mg)/k1=6mg/k1；k2 从压缩 mg/k2 到拉伸 2mg/k2，总长度增加 3mg/k2，而 C 仍刚在地面处，所以 B 上移 3mg/k2，即 ΔB=-3mg/k2。绳长不变且两竖直段绕过随 k1 移动的滑轮，满足 ΔA+ΔB=2Δp，于是 ΔA=2Δp-ΔB。所求 A、B 高度差为 ΔA-ΔB=2Δp-2ΔB=12mg/k1+6mg/k2。

In the initial state A and B are at the same height and there is no external pulling force. For equilibrium of A: the rope tension T0=mg. For equilibrium of B: the weight of B is 2mg, and the upward pulling force of the rope is mg, so k2 still needs to exert mg upward on B, indicating that k2 is compressed by mg/k2 in the initial state. The pulley is subjected to the downward pulling forces of two sections of rope, with total magnitude 2T0=2mg, so the elastic force of k1 in the initial state is 2mg. In the final state C is just about to leave the ground, the supporting force of the ground on C is 0. From equilibrium of C, the upward elastic force of k2 on C is equal to 2mg, so k2 is stretched by 2mg/k2 in the final state. At this time, the downward pulling force of k2 on B is 2mg. B is subjected to weight 2mg and the downward pulling force of the spring 2mg, so the rope tension T1=4mg. When the pulley is in equilibrium, the elastic force of k1 is 2T1=8mg. Therefore the elastic force of k1 increases from 2mg to 8mg, and the pulley moves downward by Δp=(8mg-2mg)/k1=6mg/k1. k2 changes from being compressed by mg/k2 to being stretched by 2mg/k2, and its total length increases by 3mg/k2; when C is just about to leave the ground, it is still at the ground position, so B moves upward by 3mg/k2, namely ΔB=-3mg/k2. The rope length is unchanged, and the two vertical sections of rope pass around the pulley that moves with k1, so ΔA+ΔB=2Δp. Therefore the change in the vertical coordinate difference between A and B is ΔA-ΔB=2Δp-2ΔB=12mg/k1+6mg/k2. Since A and B are at the same height in the initial state, the height difference in the final state is this value.
